"''You got that right.|Wrecker and Omega|}} A '''junkyard''' was located on the [[planet]] [[Ord Mantell]]. Between [[19 BBY]] and [[18 BBY]],{{TBBDate|205}} [[Clone Force 99]] members [[Omega]] and [[Wrecker]] went to the junkyard to find a [[compressor]]. There, Wrecker successfully located a compressor, while Omega found a [[Omega's Compass|compass]] and a few trinkets. They took their finds to [[Cid's Parlor]] in [[Ord Mantell City]]. ==Behind the scenes== The junkyard appeared in [[The Bad Batch Season 2|''The Bad Batch'' Season 2]] episode "[[Entombed]]," which released on [[January 25]], [[2023]].{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-trailer-key-art|text=Clone Force 99 Is Back in New ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 2 Trailer}} ==Appearances== *{{TBB|Entombed}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=名称不明のジャンクヤード（オード・マンテル） |ka=ჯართის უცნობი საწყობი }} [[Category:Junkyards]] [[Category:Ord Mantell locations]]
